title: そして — “and / and also”
summary: そして adds more information to what came before: ‘and’, ‘and also’, or ‘and then’. It links sentences, and it can also link adjectives. It sits at the start of a sentence or after the て-form of an adjective.

patterns.form: い形容詞のくて、そして＋形容詞
patterns.gloss: adjective-くて + そして + adjective (広くて、そして明るい)

body.p: Use そして to stack up good points or related facts: 今日は晴れです。そして、暖かいです。The two sentences usually point in the same direction (both positive or both negative).
そして can also mean ‘and then’ like それから, but it feels more like a story flowing on than a strict time step.
After joining adjectives with the て-form, そして can reinforce it: 広くて、そして明るい. For a plain list of nouns, use と instead of そして.

examples.ja: この部屋（へや）は広（ひろ）くて、そして明（あか）るいです。
examples.romaji: Kono heya wa hirokute, soshite akarui desu.
examples.tr: This room is spacious, and it's bright.
examples.note: 広くて (te-form) then そして + 明るい.

examples.ja: 今日（きょう）は晴（は）れです。そして、暖（あたた）かいです。
examples.romaji: Kyō wa hare desu. Soshite, atatakai desu.
examples.tr: Today is sunny. And it's also warm.
examples.note: Two good points in a row.

examples.ja: この店（みせ）は安（やす）いです。そして、おいしいです。
examples.romaji: Kono mise wa yasui desu. Soshite, oishii desu.
examples.tr: This shop is cheap. And also delicious.

pitfalls: Use そして for sentences and adjectives, not to link plain nouns (パンと牛乳, not パンそして牛乳).
Don't use it for contrast. For opposite ideas, use しかし or でも.
